mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I’m glad you’re here, because together, we’re about to peel back the layers on some of the most fascinating—and unsettling—stories in modern science. Have you ever wondered why, even when the facts seem clear, public debate around topics like tobacco, climate change, or environmental health can feel so uncertain… almost foggy? That’s the journey we’ll take in the world Naomi Oreskes brings to life in Merchants of Doubt. It’s a world where evidence doesn’t always win the day—where a handful of influential scientists, using their reputation and connections, have managed to cast doubt on well-established science. Instead of clarity, they’ve created confusion—shaping how we see, and sometimes misunderstand, the risks to our health, our environment, and our future. As we move through these real stories, you’ll start to see the complex mix of motivations, alliances, and strategies these figures used to blur the lines between genuine skepticism and calculated doubt. We’ll explore how science, politics, and big industries can come together—not always for the common good. These case studies aren’t just about history. They show us how easily public trust can be manipulated, and why scientific integrity and transparency matter more than ever. By the end, you’ll see that this isn’t just a battle over facts—it’s a fight for our future. So let’s dive in together, and discover what’s really behind the clouds of uncertainty.
